description: This bar chart illustrates the sample counts for two categories, “Open” and “Cons.”, across four different essay types: Narrative, Descriptive, Expository, and Argumentative. The horizontal axis displays the essay types, labeled “Narrative”, “Descriptive”, “Expository”, and “Argumentative” in that order, and represents categorical data. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks at intervals of 20. For each essay type, there are two bars representing the sample counts for “Open” and “Cons.”; the “Open” bars are light blue, and the “Cons.” bars are light pink. For the Narrative essay type, the “Open” bar reaches a value of approximately 79, while the “Cons.” bar reaches a value of 87. For the Descriptive essay type, the “Open” bar reaches a value of approximately 68, while the “Cons.” bar reaches a value of 100. For the Expository essay type, the “Open” bar reaches a value of approximately 62, while the “Cons.” bar reaches a value of 80. The bars are arranged in the order of the essay types listed on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
